notes.title: LUST Company 👾 has launched!
notes.content:
You’re the captain of a stranded space crew, surrounded by danger and desire.
Trapped by pirates, low on options, and high on tension — every choice could lead to salvation… or seduction.

What’s waiting for you among the stars:
👾 Branching story with multiple endings
👾 Logic-driven mini-games
👾 Choice-based dialogue and moral tension
👾 Intimate adult content
👾 Strategic survival in space

Start the journey now!
